task_description: Redesign the Add Inventory form and inventory/costing model: replace Product/Service + Buy/Sell/Both with a single Item Type (Part/Product vs Repair Service/Labour), introduce explicit Cost Price/Selling Price (and Service Charge/Standard Labour Cost), add a cost-scoped table + weighted-average stock-cost ledger (CP fallback, 'Cost not configured'), wire distinct Add Part / Add Service invoice paths with a double-deduction guard, compute parts/service/combined gross profit + margin behind CAP.sensitive gates, keep internal costing off customer prints, and surface flagged legacy rows. Additive/idempotent migration 0075. Follows the APPROVED Revision-4 design.
